Software Engineer at MultiSite Corp

MultiSite Corp is hiring Software Engineers across all of our offices. You can work from our New York City headquarters, our San Francisco R&D hub, our Austin engineering center, or fully remote within the United States.

About the role:
- Build scalable microservices with Java and Spring Boot
- Contribute to our data platform using Kafka and Flink
- Write clean, well-tested code with JUnit
- Participate in cross-office design reviews via video

Required:
- Java 11+ and Spring Boot
- Apache Kafka
- Microservices architecture experience
- Docker and Kubernetes
- PostgreSQL or MySQL

Benefits include relocation assistance if moving to NYC, SF, or Austin.

All engineering levels considered (IC3–IC6). Apply at multisitecorp.com/engineering
